hints.title: Distinct Subarray Window Obstacle
hints.text: Checking distinctness by building a set for every size-k window requires O(N * k) time. How can you maintain frequency counts and rolling sum simultaneously in constant time per step?

hints.title: Frequency Table Window Invariant
hints.text: Track the running sum and a frequency map of elements in the size-k window. The window has all distinct elements if and only if len(counts) == k.

hints.title: Fixed Distinct Window Procedure
hints.text: Initialize window sum and frequency map for the first k elements. If map size is k, max_sum = window_sum, else 0. Slide right: add incoming element to sum and map; decrement count of outgoing element and remove if count reaches 0. If map size is k, update max_sum = max(max_sum, window_sum).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumSubarraySum(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        from collections import defaultdict
        counts = defaultdict(int)
        curr_sum = 0
        max_sum = 0
        for i in range(k):
            counts[nums[i]] += 1
            curr_sum += nums[i]
        if len(counts) == k:
            max_sum = curr_sum
        for i in range(k, len(nums)):
            in_val, out_val = nums[i], nums[i - k]
            counts[in_val] += 1
            curr_sum += in_val
            counts[out_val] -= 1
            if counts[out_val] == 0:
                del counts[out_val]
            curr_sum -= out_val
            if len(counts) == k:
                max_sum = max(max_sum, curr_sum)
        return max_sum
```

variables: N: length of nums array (1 <= N <= 10^5)
complexity.notes: Sliding window maintaining size-k frequency map and running sum in O(1) amortized time per step.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Validating uniqueness on every length-k slice takes O(N * k) which exceeds time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Auxiliary frequency map stores at most k entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deleting keys with zero count from the map to enable O(1) distinct size verification.
